info.title: Services
info.description: The background services of this machine, as its own service manager has them: look at them, start and stop them, register a new one, remove one.

x-app.description: The background services of this machine, as its own service manager has them: look at them, start and stop them, register a new one, remove one.

methods.name: overview
methods.summary: Whether this machine has a service manager the app can use, what it can do, and every service it has, whoever registered it. Asked of the operating system on every call: nothing is kept. A machine without a manager is an answer (`manager.available` is false and says why), not an error.

methods.name: start
methods.summary: Start a service. Answers with what happened and the overview as it now stands. Needs the rights of the host process: when the operating system refuses, `status` is `denied`. A change made of several steps (`configure`) may have done some of them before the refusal: the overview in the answer shows what the machine has.

methods.name: restart
methods.summary: Stop a service and start it again; a change that is applied on a start is applied. Answers like `start`.

methods.name: configure
methods.summary: Change what the service manager keeps of a service: only the settings given change, the rest of its definition is left as it was. A setting the manager cannot change answers `unsupported`. Answers like `start`.

params.name: restart
params.description: When the manager starts it again after it ended.

methods.name: register
methods.summary: Register a new service with the service manager. It is not started. The program must be the absolute path of an executable file. Answers like `start`; `invalid` says what was wrong with what was typed.

params.name: label
params.description: The name of the new service: letters, digits and `_ . - @ :`.

params.name: program
params.description: The absolute path of an executable file.

params.name: workingDirectory
params.description: The absolute path of a directory the program starts in.

params.name: environment
params.description: The variables the program starts with.

params.name: restart
params.description: When the manager starts it again after it ended.

params.name: restartDelaySecs
params.description: Seconds the manager waits before it starts the program again.

methods.name: unregister
methods.summary: Remove a service from the service manager, whoever registered it. The program it ran is kept. Answers like `start`.

State.description: What a service is doing now.

Restart.description: When the manager starts a service again after it ended.

Status.description: How a change ended: done; refused by the operating system for want of rights (`denied`); failed; asked of a manager that cannot do it (`unsupported`); the input was wrong (`invalid`); the service is gone (`missing`).

available.description: This machine has a service manager, and it could be opened.

problem.description: Why it is not available, as a sentence; empty when it is.

installOptions.description: What a service can be registered with.

configurable.description: What can be changed of a service.

reported.description: What the manager says of a service; the rest is not available.

Service.description: A service as the manager has it. A setting the manager does not say is left out.

label.description: The manager's own name for the service.

stateDetail.description: The manager's own words about the state.

commandLine.description: The whole command, when the manager keeps one string.

path.description: The file the manager keeps the definition in.

message.description: What happened, as a sentence for the person; empty when it is done.
